gen-gf-baumans-gf-kosugi-maru: Baumans hits hard, its crescent-wrench c and uniform strokes making it commanding and distinctive. Kosugi Maru, a sans of neon-tube lines with widely spaced stroke ends, glows through paragraph after paragraph without tiring the eye.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-kumbh-sans: Distinctive from the first letter, Baumans bends its c like an opened wrench. Kumbh Sans sits below with terminals cut well short of the bowl, its fixed-pen strokes giving the display face something steadier to lean on.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-lato: Bent tubing up top: Baumans looks like one length of pipe. Lato, a sans-serif with wide s curves barely curled in, keeps a full page of text moving smoothly without fuss.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-mina: Crescent-wrench curves and uniform strokes give Baumans its loud, unmistakable look right away. And Mina, a sans with thread-plain strokes and generously unclosed small curves, gives that swagger room to breathe.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-monda: Commanding in its bent-wire round letters, Baumans also shapes its c like a crescent wrench, every stroke uniform in thickness. Baumans commands; Monda, a sans-serif, keeps small counters unclogged.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-niramit: Niramit's letter curves gape wide, giving this sans-serif a clean, professional read. Baumans does the loud work, bending its letterforms like tubing with a crescent-wrench c, while Niramit simply does the quiet reading.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-noto-sans-nko: A crescent-wrench c, horizontals matching the verticals, all commanding: that is Baumans. And where Baumans commands, Noto Sans NKo, a sans-serif with see-through c openings, stays modern throughout.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-noto-sans-shavian: Stems and arcs in lockstep, a crescent-wrench c: Baumans looks built. Noto Sans Shavian lets rope-loose curves, never knotted at the ends, carry text along smoothly line after line.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-pt-sans: Bent-tubing letterforms and a crescent-wrench c make Baumans instantly, unmistakably distinctive. PT Sans, a professional, approachable sans with c forms like open arcs, keeps reading smooth over long stretches.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-tenor-sans: Diagonals as hefty as stems and a crescent-wrench c give Baumans its command. And Tenor Sans, its c tips never touching and its strokes faintly varied, supplies a sharp difference in temperament.
